title: TokenRequest
description: Core NATS request on rta.v1.token.<vo>, served by the rucio-token queue group. The responder recomputes audience and scope from request_id and rse_id. Those two names are forbidden here even though other unknown properties are allowed.

rse_id.description: RSE the new token is for. Must be the request's source or destination. Hexadecimal or a UUID.

min_valid_s.description: Minimum remaining lifetime, in seconds, the caller will accept.
